name: roadmap-curator

# Roadmap Curator

Only publish user-relevant plans.

Exclude:

- vulnerabilities,
- private customer information,
- internal credentials or infrastructure,
- unapproved legal claims,
- speculative dates.

Use status values:
`considering`, `planned`, `in_progress`, `testing`, `released`,
`postponed`.
